steps.text:
**Short answer:** in the clean series (Yim 2020, TMA/H₂O, 300 °C, 500 nm-wide LHAR channels) the 50 % penetration depth **decreases modestly with cycle number**: 115 µm at 250 cycles → 106 µm at 500 cycles → 95 µm at 1000 cycles.

**Evidence (Yim 2020, 500 nm, 300 °C, thermal TMA/H₂O — "Fig. 9d" series varying cycle number [yim20:cmp:fig9d])**

| cycles | penetration depth, 50 % level (reflectometry, measured) | read from Fig. 9d by the KB | plateau thickness |
|---|---|---|---|
| 250 | 115 µm [yim20:tab1.r10c11#1] | 114.45 µm [yim20:fig9d#d1_2] | 25.65 nm [yim20:fig9d#d1_1] |
| 500 | 106 µm [yim20:tab1.r8c11#1] | 105.92 µm [yim20:fig9d#d2_2] | 49.9 nm [yim20:fig9d#d2_1] |
| 1000 | 95 µm [yim20:tab1.r12c11#1] | 97.40 µm [yim20:fig9d#d3_2] | 97.34 nm [yim20:fig9d#d3_1] |

- The paper states this as a hedged claim: "Film penetration measured as PD50% decreases with increasing cycle number" [yim20:s13.x2#1], resting on Fig. 9d samples 10, 8 and 11 (250, 500, 1000 cycles).
- Scale of the change: ~20 µm loss from 250 to 1000 cycles, small next to the ~±3 µm spread among 500-cycle replicates (103–109 µm [yim20:tab1.r5c11#1; yim20:tab1.r4c11#1; yim20:tab1.r6c11#1; yim20:tab1.r8c11#1], the replicate set [yim20:cmp:1]).
- A second 500-cycle measurement on the same film in Fig. 9a gives 105.94 µm [yim20:fig9a#d2_2], consistent with the 106 µm of Fig. 9d.
- For sample 11 (1000 cycles) a different metric is also recorded: the film visually penetrates ~125 µm under the top membrane (SEM–EDS) [yim20:s10.x2#1], larger than its 50 %-level value of 95 µm — different definitions, not a disagreement flagged by the KB.

**Not comparable / open**
- Ylilammi 2018 (same precursors, 300 °C, 0.5 µm, 500 cycles) reports 134.4 µm measured [yli18:fig6#2] and 133.7 µm simulated [yli18:fig6#4], but at 300 Pa and a 1 mm-long channel [yli18:s8.p23#4; yli18:s8.p24#12], so it does not extend the cycle series.
- Gao 2015 (same precursors, 300 °C, 500 nm, 1109 cycles) gives 71.5 µm at the 50 % level [gao15:fig5a#2], the film extending ~65 µm [gao15:s6.p18#1] and roughly constant to ~52 µm [gao15:s6.p21#1] — again a different structure (pillar layout, 1–2 mbar), so its lower value cannot be attributed to cycle number from the KB.
- No sample at 500 nm/300 °C with cycles other than 250, 500, 1000 (and the 1109-cycle Gao run) is recorded; no conflict between a sample's own and inherited conditions was reported for these samples.
